title: Skala: a deep-learning exchange-correlation functional
summary: It comes close to the 1 kcal/mol threshold on the W4-17 benchmark (0.85 kcal/mol on the single-reference subset) and is competitive with leading hybrid functionals on GMTKN55 at lower cost. It was trained on about 150,000 high-accuracy energy differences, roughly 100 times the previous dataset size. Accuracy is shown only within the training data's chemical space; it was not yet public at the time.

evidence.tested: Skala was evaluated on the W4-17 atomization benchmark, reaching 0.85 kcal/mol on the single-reference subset, and on GMTKN55, where it was competitive with hybrid functionals.
evidence.unknown: Accuracy is claimed only within the training data chemical space, expansion to broader chemistry is at an early stage, and the functional was not yet public.
evidence.ai_role: A deep-learning exchange-correlation functional learned from about 150,000 high-accuracy energy differences.
